notes: Initial N-14 8C (filed 2021-05-14) of the newly formed Nuveen Multi-Asset Income Fund (to list on the NYSE as NMAI) for the reorganizations of JDD, JTA and JTD into it. Exchange is NAV for NAV (cash in lieu of fractional shares). Each reorganization closes only if at least one other Target Fund (i.e. at least two of three) also obtains approval and satisfies its conditions ('other'). Meeting date, record date and the expected effective date are blank placeholders ('[ ], 2021', 'on or about [ ], 2021 or as soon as practicable thereafter'), so meeting_date, record_date and expected_close are null. The form of Agreement and Plan of Reorganization has no outside date (termination is by mutual agreement or for breach, unmet condition, or a Board determination), so termination_date is null. 'board_discretion' is the Section 11.1(c) right of a Target Fund Board or the Acquiring Fund Board to terminate on determining the deal is not in its fund's best interests; it is a termination right rather than a closing condition, hence listed as uncertain. There is no NYSE listing condition among the conditions precedent (listing approval is a covenant, Section 5.8). The agreement also requires a final income distribution (8.5, not mapped).
